summary.text: Threadline Delivery built a single-manager purchasing pilot for one office. Staff created purchase requests and managers approved a specific request revision.

evidence.quote: Threadline Delivery built a single-manager purchasing pilot for one office. Staff created purchase requests and managers approved a specific request revision.

problem.text: Office staff previously emailed item lists to their manager. When a quantity changed, an old approval could remain attached to an outdated list. The client needed one place to see the requested items, the current total, and the revision that a manager had actually approved. The pilot covered office supplies only; it did not place orders or move money.

evidence.quote: Office staff previously emailed item lists to their manager. When a quantity changed, an old approval could remain attached to an outdated list. The client needed one place to see the requested items, the current total, and the revision that a manager had actually approved. The pilot covered office supplies only; it did not place orders or move money.

approach.text: Approval was bound to a request revision rather than a mutable request row. A transaction inserted the decision and changed state only when the submitted revision still matched the manager's screen. A stale manager screen received a conflict and had to reload. The design deliberately kept rejected and superseded revisions rather than overwriting their item lists.

evidence.quote: Approval was bound to a request revision rather than a mutable request row. A transaction inserted the decision and changed state only when the submitted revision still matched the manager's screen. A stale manager screen received a conflict and had to reload. The design deliberately kept rejected and superseded revisions rather than overwriting their item lists.

results.text: The one-office pilot was accepted for request submission, single-manager review, revision checks, and inspection of request events. No finance approval stage was delivered.

evidence.quote: The one-office pilot was accepted for request submission, single-manager review, revision checks, and inspection of request events. No finance approval stage was delivered.

lessons.text: An approval must identify the exact request revision it authorizes. A later edit requires a new decision; preserving an old decision is not permission to reuse it.

evidence.quote: An approval must identify the exact request revision it authorizes. A later edit requires a new decision; preserving an old decision is not permission to reuse it.

gaps.text: Approval-time savings, multi-branch behavior, and finance routing were not measured or implemented in this pilot. The client accepted a narrow workflow, not a general purchasing platform.

evidence.quote: Approval-time savings, multi-branch behavior, and finance routing were not measured or implemented in this pilot. The client accepted a narrow workflow, not a general purchasing platform.

summary.text: Threadline Delivery built an expense-claim portal. Retry testing exposed duplicate claim creation, and a stable operation key plus a database constraint prevented the same operation from creating another claim.

evidence.quote: Threadline Delivery built an expense-claim portal. Retry testing exposed duplicate claim creation, and a stable operation key plus a database constraint prevented the same operation from creating another claim.

problem.text: Consultants submitted receipt details from mobile browsers. A slow response made it unclear whether the server had received a claim, so users pressed Send again or retried after reconnecting. An early prototype treated each HTTP request as a new claim. The business needed reliable recording of a claim before any separate human reimbursement process could begin.

evidence.quote: Consultants submitted receipt details from mobile browsers. A slow response made it unclear whether the server had received a claim, so users pressed Send again or retried after reconnecting. An early prototype treated each HTTP request as a new claim. The business needed reliable recording of a claim before any separate human reimbursement process could begin.

approach.text: The stable operation key was scoped to the submitting employee. A unique database constraint on employee_id and operation_key serialized duplicate creation attempts. The server stored a normalized payload fingerprint with the claim. Reusing a key with a different payload returned a conflict instead of silently attaching changed receipt details to the first claim.

evidence.quote: The stable operation key was scoped to the submitting employee. A unique database constraint on employee_id and operation_key serialized duplicate creation attempts. The server stored a normalized payload fingerprint with the claim. Reusing a key with a different payload returned a conflict instead of silently attaching changed receipt details to the first claim.

results.text: After the repair, controlled lost-response and concurrent-retry checks produced one claim record per matching operation. A changed payload with the same operation key was rejected.

evidence.quote: After the repair, controlled lost-response and concurrent-retry checks produced one claim record per matching operation. A changed payload with the same operation key was rejected.

lessons.text: Keep one stable operation key across retries and enforce uniqueness in the database. A disabled button alone does not protect against duplicate server writes.

evidence.quote: Keep one stable operation key across retries and enforce uniqueness in the database. A disabled button alone does not protect against duplicate server writes.

gaps.text: Production reliability, offline queuing, intentional duplicate-receipt detection, and a long-term operation-key retention policy were not established.

evidence.quote: Production reliability, offline queuing, intentional duplicate-receipt detection, and a long-term operation-key retention policy were not established.

summary.text: Threadline Delivery built a workspace for checking supplier documents. It distinguished an incomplete checklist, a review in progress, and a supplier accepted for the client's directory.

evidence.quote: Threadline Delivery built a workspace for checking supplier documents. It distinguished an incomplete checklist, a review in progress, and a supplier accepted for the client's directory.

problem.text: Purchasing staff collected supplier contact details and business documents in email threads. A filled form was sometimes mistaken for a completed review. The client needed a visible checklist with the identity of the person who checked each document. The software was intended to organize the client's own process, not certify a supplier or perform independent due diligence.

evidence.quote: Purchasing staff collected supplier contact details and business documents in email threads. A filled form was sometimes mistaken for a completed review. The client needed a visible checklist with the identity of the person who checked each document. The software was intended to organize the client's own process, not certify a supplier or perform independent due diligence.

approach.text: Document presence and supplier acceptance were stored as separate states. A required_document row described the item and checklist version, while document_check recorded reviewer, timestamp, source version, and result. The accept transition required completed checks for the active checklist. Upload success alone never set the supplier to accepted.

evidence.quote: Document presence and supplier acceptance were stored as separate states. A required_document row described the item and checklist version, while document_check recorded reviewer, timestamp, source version, and result. The accept transition required completed checks for the active checklist. Upload success alone never set the supplier to accepted.

results.text: The delivered workflow blocked directory acceptance while required document checks were incomplete and reopened the affected check after document replacement.

evidence.quote: The delivered workflow blocked directory acceptance while required document checks were incomplete and reopened the affected check after document replacement.

lessons.text: Separate document collection, human review, and business authorization. A complete checklist is evidence that a process ran, not proof that every downstream action is permitted.

evidence.quote: Separate document collection, human review, and business authorization. A complete checklist is evidence that a process ran, not proof that every downstream action is permitted.

gaps.text: Bank validation, supplier risk assessment, and purchase authorization were outside the delivered scope. No reduction in onboarding effort was measured.

evidence.quote: Bank validation, supplier risk assessment, and purchase authorization were outside the delivered scope. No reduction in onboarding effort was measured.

summary.text: Threadline Delivery piloted invoice matching against purchase records. Unresolved matching errors caused the pilot to be stopped, and staff completed the cycle with the existing manual process.

evidence.quote: Threadline Delivery piloted invoice matching against purchase records. Unresolved matching errors caused the pilot to be stopped, and staff completed the cycle with the existing manual process.

problem.text: Accounts staff compared supplier invoices with purchase references and received-item records. A prototype tried to match on supplier display name and a normalized purchase reference. Several references were missing or reused, and similar supplier names made an apparently convenient matching rule unsafe. The client wanted less manual reconciliation, but that benefit remained a goal rather than an observed result.

evidence.quote: Accounts staff compared supplier invoices with purchase references and received-item records. A prototype tried to match on supplier display name and a normalized purchase reference. Several references were missing or reused, and similar supplier names made an apparently convenient matching rule unsafe. The client wanted less manual reconciliation, but that benefit remained a goal rather than an observed result.

approach.text: After reviewing the defects, the team required stable supplier identifiers, explicit purchase revisions, and a reason for every accepted exception. A batch could not advance while unresolved reconciliation items remained. These were corrective design decisions for a possible future iteration; they were not implemented and validated as a successful replacement pilot during this project.

evidence.quote: After reviewing the defects, the team required stable supplier identifiers, explicit purchase revisions, and a reason for every accepted exception. A batch could not advance while unresolved reconciliation items remained. These were corrective design decisions for a possible future iteration; they were not implemented and validated as a successful replacement pilot during this project.

results.text: The invoice-matching pilot was stopped because unresolved matching errors remained. Staff completed the cycle manually; no automated posting was performed.

evidence.quote: The invoice-matching pilot was stopped because unresolved matching errors remained. Staff completed the cycle manually; no automated posting was performed.

lessons.text: Do not treat a populated match field or a completed manual fallback as proof that automation succeeded. Preserve unresolved exceptions and block dependent actions until the reconciliation rule is agreed.

evidence.quote: Do not treat a populated match field or a completed manual fallback as proof that automation succeeded. Preserve unresolved exceptions and block dependent actions until the reconciliation rule is agreed.

gaps.text: A repaired matching service, measured time savings, accepted tolerance rules, and production matching accuracy were not established.

evidence.quote: A repaired matching service, measured time savings, accepted tolerance rules, and production matching accuracy were not established.

summary.text: Threadline Delivery built a branch inventory request portal. Branch staff saw their own records, while explicitly assigned central reviewers could inspect requests across branches.

evidence.quote: Threadline Delivery built a branch inventory request portal. Branch staff saw their own records, while explicitly assigned central reviewers could inspect requests across branches.

problem.text: Branch staff requested stock transfers using a shared spreadsheet. Filters were convenient for navigation but did not prevent someone from opening another branch's record. The client wanted clear branch ownership and a central review role. The project concerned internal stock-transfer requests, not purchasing new stock from suppliers or recording financial approval.

evidence.quote: Branch staff requested stock transfers using a shared spreadsheet. Filters were convenient for navigation but did not prevent someone from opening another branch's record. The client wanted clear branch ownership and a central review role. The project concerned internal stock-transfer requests, not purchasing new stock from suppliers or recording financial approval.

approach.text: Authorization was enforced in server-side record queries and writes, not only in the list screen. The server resolved branch membership from the signed-in employee and checked the target record's stored branch. A central review capability was separate from a branch requester's assignment. This prevented a user from changing a URL or request body to obtain a different branch's records.

evidence.quote: Authorization was enforced in server-side record queries and writes, not only in the list screen. The server resolved branch membership from the signed-in employee and checked the target record's stored branch. A central review capability was separate from a branch requester's assignment. This prevented a user from changing a URL or request body to obtain a different branch's records.

results.text: The two-branch acceptance checks rejected unauthorized cross-branch reads and writes while allowing an explicitly assigned central reviewer to inspect both branches.

evidence.quote: The two-branch acceptance checks rejected unauthorized cross-branch reads and writes while allowing an explicitly assigned central reviewer to inspect both branches.

lessons.text: Check the actor's current assignment against the record's stored branch on every server read and write. A filtered list does not establish authorization.

evidence.quote: Check the actor's current assignment against the record's stored branch on every server read and write. A filtered list does not establish authorization.

gaps.text: Automatic directory synchronization, staff-transfer policy, purchasing authority, and real stock movement were outside the pilot's evidence.

evidence.quote: Automatic directory synchronization, staff-transfer policy, purchasing authority, and real stock movement were outside the pilot's evidence.

summary.text: Threadline Delivery built an event-history export for internal reviewers. Each exported event identified its actor, server timestamp, action, record revision, and export scope.

evidence.quote: Threadline Delivery built an event-history export for internal reviewers. Each exported event identified its actor, server timestamp, action, record revision, and export scope.

problem.text: Reviewers could see a request's final state but could not reliably explain how it reached that state. A spreadsheet download sometimes changed while a reviewer paged through it, making row counts difficult to reconcile. The client needed a bounded event-history export and a visible statement of the filters and time range used to generate it.

evidence.quote: Reviewers could see a request's final state but could not reliably explain how it reached that state. A spreadsheet download sometimes changed while a reviewer paged through it, making row counts difficult to reconcile. The client needed a bounded event-history export and a visible statement of the filters and time range used to generate it.

approach.text: Application users could append new events through normal state transitions but could not edit or delete earlier events through the dashboard. Corrections were new events referencing the earlier record. The team deliberately used append-only at the application layer rather than claiming that this design alone established immutable infrastructure or formal compliance.

evidence.quote: Application users could append new events through normal state transitions but could not edit or delete earlier events through the dashboard. Corrections were new events referencing the earlier record. The team deliberately used append-only at the application layer rather than claiming that this design alone established immutable infrastructure or formal compliance.

results.text: The pilot export included the selected authorized events through its cutoff, with actor, timestamp, action, revision, and a recorded export scope.

evidence.quote: The pilot export included the selected authorized events through its cutoff, with actor, timestamp, action, revision, and a recorded export scope.

lessons.text: Record event provenance and export boundaries. Preserve corrections as new events, and avoid describing an application event log as tamper-proof or compliant without separate evidence.

evidence.quote: Record event provenance and export boundaries. Preserve corrections as new events, and avoid describing an application event log as tamper-proof or compliant without separate evidence.

gaps.text: Retention policy, legal compliance, privileged-administrator tamper resistance, and maximum export capacity were not established.

evidence.quote: Retention policy, legal compliance, privileged-administrator tamper resistance, and maximum export capacity were not established.

summary.text: Threadline Delivery built leave-request review with time-bounded manager delegation. It recorded the acting reviewer and the manager on whose behalf a decision was made.

evidence.quote: Threadline Delivery built leave-request review with time-bounded manager delegation. It recorded the acting reviewer and the manager on whose behalf a decision was made.

problem.text: Leave requests waited when a manager was unavailable. Staff needed a named temporary reviewer instead of sharing manager credentials or treating an email reply as permanent permission. The team needed a way to explain who acted and why that person had authority at the time of the decision. This was a staffing workflow, with no financial spending limits.

evidence.quote: Leave requests waited when a manager was unavailable. Staff needed a named temporary reviewer instead of sharing manager credentials or treating an email reply as permanent permission. The team needed a way to explain who acted and why that person had authority at the time of the decision. This was a staffing workflow, with no financial spending limits.

approach.text: A delegation was an explicit record with principal manager, delegate, allowed action, start, and expiry. The server evaluated it when approving, rather than caching a permanent delegate flag in the browser. Approval history recorded the actual actor and the principal. A delegate could not create another delegation to an additional person.

evidence.quote: A delegation was an explicit record with principal manager, delegate, allowed action, start, and expiry. The server evaluated it when approving, rather than caching a permanent delegate flag in the browser. Approval history recorded the actual actor and the principal. A delegate could not create another delegation to an additional person.

results.text: The manager-delegation pilot accepted decisions within an active assignment, rejected expired authority, and retained the actual acting reviewer in history.

evidence.quote: The manager-delegation pilot accepted decisions within an active assignment, rejected expired authority, and retained the actual acting reviewer in history.

lessons.text: Represent delegated authority explicitly, evaluate it at decision time, and retain the actual actor. Do not infer spending authority from an unrelated managerial role.

evidence.quote: Represent delegated authority explicitly, evaluate it at decision time, and retain the actual actor. Do not infer spending authority from an unrelated managerial role.

gaps.text: Financial authorization, purchasing delegation policy, directory synchronization, and staffing benefits were not established.

evidence.quote: Financial authorization, purchasing delegation policy, directory synchronization, and staffing benefits were not established.

summary.text: Threadline Delivery built an editorial approval tool for marketing drafts. It supported comments, review notifications, and publication scheduling; it did not authorize purchases or financial commitments.

evidence.quote: Threadline Delivery built an editorial approval tool for marketing drafts. It supported comments, review notifications, and publication scheduling; it did not authorize purchases or financial commitments.

problem.text: Editors exchanged campaign drafts through email and lost track of which comments needed a response. The client wanted a visible review queue and a notification when a draft needed attention. Content could continue changing during editorial review. The business intentionally preferred flexible collaboration over treating every text edit as a new financial authorization decision.

evidence.quote: Editors exchanged campaign drafts through email and lost track of which comments needed a response. The client wanted a visible review queue and a notification when a draft needed attention. Content could continue changing during editorial review. The business intentionally preferred flexible collaboration over treating every text edit as a new financial authorization decision.

approach.text: The client chose editable drafts and lightweight review markers. A notification linked to the current draft, and the editor checked final text before scheduling. The team explicitly declined a revision-locked sign-off because that was not the agreed editorial workflow. This choice was suitable for the stated pilot but was never validated for authorization of money or goods.

evidence.quote: The client chose editable drafts and lightweight review markers. A notification linked to the current draft, and the editor checked final text before scheduling. The team explicitly declined a revision-locked sign-off because that was not the agreed editorial workflow. This choice was suitable for the stated pilot but was never validated for authorization of money or goods.

results.text: The editorial pilot delivered draft comments, review notifications, and scheduling status. It did not deliver revision-bound financial approval.

evidence.quote: The editorial pilot delivered draft comments, review notifications, and scheduling status. It did not deliver revision-bound financial approval.

lessons.text: A familiar approval label does not establish equivalent business authority. Reuse notification and work-queue ideas only after checking the new workflow's decision and revision requirements.

evidence.quote: A familiar approval label does not establish equivalent business authority. Reuse notification and work-queue ideas only after checking the new workflow's decision and revision requirements.

gaps.text: Financial authorization, amount thresholds, immutable approved revisions, and purchasing outcomes were outside this project's scope.

evidence.quote: Financial authorization, amount thresholds, immutable approved revisions, and purchasing outcomes were outside this project's scope.

summary.text: Threadline Delivery proposed a purchasing expansion with amount-based finance review. The client paused the proposal before implementation, so it supplies design discussion but no delivered precedent or achieved outcome.

evidence.quote: Threadline Delivery proposed a purchasing expansion with amount-based finance review. The client paused the proposal before implementation, so it supplies design discussion but no delivered precedent or achieved outcome.

problem.text: After its one-office purchasing pilot, Meadow considered expansion to additional offices. The proposal described manager approval followed by finance review above a configurable threshold. The client had not agreed the threshold, finance assignment ownership, or handling of edits between stages. These were questions for discovery, not rules already operating in a delivered system.

evidence.quote: After its one-office purchasing pilot, Meadow considered expansion to additional offices. The proposal described manager approval followed by finance review above a configurable threshold. approach.text: The design discussion favored a versioned approval-policy definition rather than a hard-coded finance flag. A proposed decision record would identify policy version, stage, actor, and request revision. The note explains a possible approach and alternatives; none of the proposed tables or endpoints was implemented under this project. The original pilot's delivered behavior was not changed.

A proposed decision record would identify policy version, stage, actor, and request revision. lessons.text: Treat an unimplemented proposal as an option to investigate, not a proven solution. Separate an intended workflow, a preliminary estimate, and an executed acceptance result.

evidence.quote: Treat an unimplemented proposal as an option to investigate, not a proven solution. Separate an intended workflow, a preliminary estimate, and an executed acceptance result.

gaps.text: The finance threshold, policy ownership, implementation, test execution, delivery estimate, and business outcomes were not established for this proposal.

evidence.quote: The finance threshold, policy ownership, implementation, test execution, delivery estimate, and business outcomes were not established for this proposal.
